description: This file defines the MenuService class, which manages the menu system in the OrangeHRM application. It includes methods for retrieving, caching, and normalizing menu items, handling permissions, and configuration of menu structure based on user roles and module context.

classes.name: MenuService
classes.description: Provides services for managing application menus, including retrieval, caching, normalization, and permission handling for user interface menu structures in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getMenuDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the MenuDao instance used for database interactions related to menus.

methods.name: getScreenPermissionService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the ScreenPermissionService object responsible for permission-related operations.

methods.name: enableModuleMenuItems
methods.description: Enables menu items for a specific module and clears related cache attributes for the authenticated user.

methods.name: invalidateCachedMenuItems
methods.description: Clears cached menu items to force refresh on next retrieval.

methods.name: getDetailedSidePanelMenuItemsAlongWithCache
methods.description: Retrieves detailed side panel menu items, caching them for performance.

methods.name: getTopMenuItemsAlongWithCache
methods.description: Retrieves top menu items for a given side panel menu item, utilizing cache.

methods.name: generateCacheKeyForTopMenuItem
methods.description: Creates a cache key string based on a side panel menu item ID.

methods.name: getMenuItems
methods.description: Main method to retrieve normalized menu items based on current context and URL.

methods.name: getMenuItemChainForMenuItem
methods.description: Builds a chain of parent menu items starting from a given menu item.

methods.name: isActiveSidePanelMenuItem
methods.description: Determines if a side panel menu item is active based on context and configuration.

methods.name: isActiveTopMenuItem
methods.description: Checks if a top menu item is active based on current module and screen context.

methods.name: normalizeMenuItem
methods.description: Converts a DetailedMenuItem object into a normalized array suitable for frontend display, including URL and active state.

methods.name: normalizeTopMenuItem
methods.description: Normalizes a detailed top menu item, including child items, and filters out inactive or irrelevant items.
